status: source-only; owned source/tests frozen for parent full-core verification and packaging
diagnosis: Mirror manifest/files waited for CloudArchive.prepare full filesystem/FTS materialization while continuous uploads advanced the authoritative revision.
implementation: Canonical source-backed mirror workers skip filesystem and FTS construction.
One-conversation manifest buffering; streaming ordered section hashing; cumulative 64000000-byte bound checked during manifest and selected-file source iteration.
File pages retain 1000000-character slices, 2000000-character response budget and 32-path request limit.
Metadata-only cache: eight owners and at most 10000 complete document entries, with compact authority stamps for larger catalogs.
Workers share existing per-database 2 active / 8 waiting live-read slots; concurrent owner/revision manifest requests coalesce.
Owner, source visibility, membership/grant, binding generation, account, revision and expiry checks remain on canonical source reads and final release.
Unified-only asOf reflects latest included source observation rather than epoch zero.

64-lowercase-hex projection digest covers exact owner/revision/expiry/metadata/content-digest/index projection. New native persists it after publication and sends knownProjection on head and final checks.
Cached projection equality and canonical recomputation survive metadata eviction without a schema or global revision change.

compatibility.legacy041: Ordinary safe cached path stays compatible; metadata eviction can still fail closed. Legacy unpinned heads return full metadata when an expired grant prevents raw revision equality from proving the old view.
compatibility.legacyServer: Native still accepts legacy projection-free fixtures/servers before a projection handshake is established; a missing proof after an established handshake fails closed.

firstAttempt.reason: Both mirror requests still called full archive prepare; retained transcription in mirror66-before.log.

limits: Synthetic measurements are local source-read timings/RSS, not a production result or an old full-build timing comparison.
Continuous uploads may still require revision restarts; runtime74 verified-file reuse remains in place.
Live readiness, installation and deployment remain for parent verification.
